speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. I see a newborn presenting with a generalized rash; to help me determine the cause, have you noticed any fever, poor feeding, or difficulty breathing alongside the rash? Please also describe the appearance of the rash, such as whether it is itchy, blistery, or has a specific color.

speaker: Patient
text: 4-day-old newborn. The newborn was born at term with no complications. The mother had no prenatal care and has a history of gonorrhea treated 4 years ago. The newborn presents with a generalized rash that has been present for 1 day.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Neonatal Gonococcal Dermatitis. Given the history of maternal gonorrhea and the 4-day-old age of the newborn, this presentation is highly suspicious for a disseminated gonococcal infection. REQUEST TEST: Gram stain of skin pustules and Blood culture. REQUEST IMAGES: Clinical photos of the rash lesions.
